clips.title: The story
paras: At Skull Rock in Durotar, Burning Blade cultists wear Searing Collars in their rites. The heated torcs burn their flesh as the cultists attune themselves to demonic power.

The Burning Blade gathers for dark rites in Skull Rock, just east of Orgrimmar. Cultists, neophytes, and thugs wear Searing Collars around their necks, enduring heat that brands and sears their skin. Margoz, a hermit, studies the cruel devices. He suspects the burning and the enchantments bound to the metal attune the wearers to demonic energies. What part do these collars play in the corruption spreading through orc society under the Horde’s nose?
